title: Squirrel Sightings (Optional) Part a)
body: The table squirrel below contains some information on reported squirrel sightings across the Berkeley campus. Each row in the squirrel table represents one unique squirrel sighting. Write a line of code that evaluates to the proportion of Squirrel IDs in the table that are even.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: The image shows a description and a table related to squirrel sightings on the Berkeley campus. The table is titled squirrel and contains five columns: Squirrel ID, Location, Day, Month, and Year. Squirrel ID is a unique identification number for each squirrel. Location is the common name of the nearest campus landmark where the squirrel was spotted. Month is the numerical representation of the month when the squirrel was spotted. Day is the day of the month when the squirrel was spotted. Year is the year when the squirrel was spotted. The table includes the following data: Row 1: 2937, Wheeler Hall, 17, 3, 2024; Row 2: 8421, East Asian Library, 28, 9, 2022; Row 3: 472, Etcheverry Hall, 7, 1, 2024; Row 4: 239, Campbell Hall, 4, 10, 2023; Row 5: 2937, Moffitt Library, 7, 6, 2021.
